title: ChaosWallFX: bullet-damaged concrete wall
description:
A concrete wall that breaks under accumulated bullet damage.

The first shot leaves a crater and dust; nearby hits release chunks; several open a hole through the wall to the rebar. Debris stays on the floor and everything kicks up grey dust.

Chaos destruction with Niagara. Materials are built with nodes only and the Niagara systems use stock modules.

title: MolotovFX: molotov explosion
description:
A molotov that behaves the same whether it breaks mid-air or on impact.

The fuel splashes out, ignites into a fireball, then falls with real collision against the level and the fire grows where it lands. Walls stop the fuel, so a corner keeps the fire contained. Burning puddles stay as decals.

Stock Niagara modules, node-only materials and quality scalability through an Effect Type.

title: GunFX: muzzle flash and impacts
description:
Weapon VFX with a dusty, grounded look.

Shotgun as a single system for 8 pellets, impacts for concrete, metal and flesh (a liquid splatter simulated in Maya Bifrost and rendered in Arnold as a flipbook), wound decals and short light pulses.

Performance pass: no GPU sorting, cutout instead of translucency on flashes and smoke, and a pooling test. Materials with nodes only.

title: SandstormFX: dense sandstorm
description:
A dense sandstorm for exteriors and interiors, with the Steam Deck as the minimum target.

One Material Parameter Collection drives both the post-process veil and the particles. A controller adds gusts, wind travel and interior volumes, and everything can be animated in Sequencer or Blueprint.

title: PaperFX: papers kicked by footsteps
description:
Newspapers and posters on the floor that react to footsteps.

Each step kicks them: they slide, lift, spin and land flat again, sometimes face down. A second system sends papers across the scene with the wind.

Two GPU Niagara systems with no Blueprint or runtime code: node-only material and modules built from nodes.

title: PixelDiorama Kit
description:
Unreal Engine plugin that puts pixel-art characters inside real 3D environments: lit by the scene, casting shadows, with the tilt-shift look of a miniature diorama.

Aseprite import, 8-direction sprite baking from 3D characters, 11 look presets, pixel-art weather and effects, a playable walker with dialogue, and an editor panel. C++ source and 160+ Blueprint functions.
